notes.title: October 12 Update
notes.content:
Patch notes October 12, 2021:
-Added control tooltips to necessary interactive elements so players don't need to memorize controls
-Fixed the back button not working on level select
-Adjusted balance and some behind-the-scenes aspects of various levels

Still to come:
-Updated, more responsive menus (particularly the beginning menu)
